analysis.rationale: Strong YoY growth in PAT (156%) and total income (141%) across key segments like NBFC AUM (2.6x YoY) and payments bank deposits (1.7x YoY) indicate accelerating business momentum.
analysis.summary: Jio Financial Services reported Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT of ₹830 crore, up 156% YoY, with total income (ex-dividend) up 141% YoY to ₹1,496 crore.
